'''Balkar Interior Refurbishments''' was a store located in the [[Red Light Sector Concourse]], in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was a front for [[Jonas Balkar]], an agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
